source_review.identity: Printed XM621, LM register to XY register bits 60-61-62 via mixer title and part 2586186 agree with the native source.
source_review.coverage: Compared the complete native overview, nine enlarged source sectors and complete 245x103 UTF-8 preview.
key_findings: Bit 60 and bit 61 mixer groups each use four A portions, an OR and resistor tap; bit 62 uses three 0500 A portions and a three-way OR without a printed resistor.
The bit 62 negative output goes to XM675, while bit 60 and bit 61 negatives go to XM635. Positive branches and the distinct stacked page references agree with the native scan.
Four format rails branch at printed diamonds across all three groups; unmarked crossings remain separate. All 22 card portions, 41 printed input terminals, source labels and footer agree.
source_review.validation: PASS: 22/22 direct A1 card portions; 41 printed input terminals; 103 rows x 245 columns; no unsupported characters, duplicate pins, disconnected nets, hidden junctions, text collisions or unreadable characters. Public text and preview hashes match the frozen private draft.

invalidation: Any change to source or an accepted artifact requires a new native and preview audit before acceptance.
